senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n., שער הח׳ Gate of Ḥarsith, one of the Jerusalem gates.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:15">Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ</cite> (the Eastern gate) was called <he>שער חריסית שהוא מכוון וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) Gate of Ḥ., because it was facing the East; v. <cite ref="H01725"><he>חֶרֶס</he> II</cite>.
